description_en: Queries the SSL servers that have been created
description_zh: 调用DescribeSslVpnServers接口查询已创建的SSL-VPN服务端
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ssl-vpn-servers --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ssl-vpn-server-id vss-bp15j3du13gq1dgey0000 --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1on0xae9d771ggi0000 --name test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSslVpnServers

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SSL server. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
SSL-VPN服务端所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL server
parameters.name: ssl_vpn_server_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SSL server.

The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
SSL-VPN服务端的名称。

长度为1～100个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the SSL server belongs.

The SSL server belongs to the same resource group as the associated VPN gateway instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2794055.html operation to query the resource group ID of the VPN gateway instance
parameters.help_zh:
SSL-VPN服务端所属的资源组ID。

SSL-VPN服务端与其关联的VPN网关实例的资源组相同。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2794055.html接口查询VPN网关实例所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
